company_name: HPRAY (CHANGZHOU) CLEAN SYSTEM TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides critical components for semiconductor fabrication processes, particularly in cleanroom environments.
summary: HPRAY (Changzhou) Clean System Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in manufacturing semiconductor-grade fittings and components, such as PFA butt-fusion, sleeve-fusion, and flared fittings. These products are essential for maintaining contamination control in semiconductor fabrication processes, including chemical vapor deposition.
capabilities: Class 100 cleanroom packaging and cleaning processes
